evidence: Adds consensus parameters and chain validation rules for Testnet 5 (BIP 95) in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp.
rationale: Adds consensus parameters for Testnet 5 (BIP 95) to provide a resilient public test network. By dropping 'the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception of Testnet 3/4', raising minimum difficulty, and enforcing 'BIP 54 from block 1', it resolves long-standing testnet block storm and difficulty manipulation vulnerabilities.
